extension.description: Motor interno de Nicode Web Monitor — Conector. Configura la vinculación desde Componentes → Nicode Web Monitor — Conector.

field.name: connection_help
field.label: Nicode Web Monitor — Conector
field.description: Configura la vinculación en Componentes → Nicode Web Monitor — Conector. La identidad y las credenciales se generan automáticamente.

field.name: backup_token_hash
field.label: Backup credential SHA-256 digest
field.description: Separate from inventory. Empty disables backups. Never paste the credential itself.

field.name: backup_storage
field.label: Private backup directory
field.description: Absolute directory outside every web root, restricted to the service account. Pre-create operations and snapshots subdirectories. See docs/maintenance.txt before enabling.

field.name: update_token_hash
field.label: Update credential SHA-256 digest
field.description: Must differ from inventory and backup. Empty disables updates.

field.name: update_storage
field.label: Private update directory
field.description: Locally vetted packages and operation permits. Outside all web roots. See docs/maintenance.txt.

field.name: maintenance_storage
field.label: Shared private maintenance directory
field.description: Required for backups and updates. One directory per installation shared by HTTP and CLI; never clear an unresolved owner without inspecting effects.

field.name: core_token_hash
field.label: Core update credential SHA-256 digest
field.description: Must differ from inventory, backups and extension updates. HTTP queues a prepared operation; an explicit local CLI performs it. Empty disables core requests.
